grammar.N: Emit file + :: + shared name prefix + exact suffix + LF.
grammar.P: Set exact parameterized name = shared name prefix + suffix; emit no node.
grammar.A: Emit file + :: + parameterized function name + exact bracketed argument suffix + LF.
grammar.S: Set exact shared name prefix within this file; prepend to N/P suffix.

policy: Every logical name and argument is readable. Prefix sharing only; preserve ordered node byte reconstruction exactly.
